plan.title: SHG Loan Repayment Report
plan.subtitle: Overview of SHG loan repayment status and purposes

panels.title: Repayment Status Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Repayment Status", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Loans by Purpose
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Overdue Loans by Purpose
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "shg_loan_register" WHERE "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

plan.narrative: This report provides insights into the repayment status of SHG loans. The pie chart ({{p1}}) illustrates the distribution of loans across different repayment statuses: Closed, Overdue, and Regular. The bar chart ({{p2}}) shows the number of loans disbursed for various purposes such as Agriculture, Education, Health, Housing, Livestock, and Petty trade. Additionally, the bar chart ({{p3}}) focuses on overdue loans, highlighting the purposes for which these loans were taken. This information can help in understanding the areas where financial support is most needed and where repayment challenges are prevalent.
